how to slow internet

how to slow internet is an artist project centrally focused on experimentation with small scale communication technology in order to better consider the large scale communications infrastructure on which we increasingly depend.

solar server completed at Deurendis

2025-10-04

Begun during the first Earth Camp in August 2025, the solar web server is now installed at Deurendis in New York.

what resources did we need to build the solar server?

Earth Camp 2025

2025-10-04

For three days, folks gathered in person at Deurendis in New York to share research and build a solar web server. There's more to do, but the solar server is almost complete and will be installed at Deurendis and will be available for public use soon.
